originalTitle: Tax-free bond yields are in a sweet spot. Get in before it’s too late.
summary: Yields on municipal bonds — adjusted for taxable-equivalent comparisons — have widened dramatically over those of corporate bonds over the past two months.
content: Yields on municipal bonds — adjusted for taxable-equivalent comparisons — have widened dramatically over those of corporate bonds over the past two months.
chineseTitle: 免税债券收益率处于最佳状态。在为时已晚之前加入。
chineseSummary: 过去两个月，市政债券的收益率（根据应税等值比较进行调整）比公司债券的收益率大幅上升。
chineseContent: 过去两个月，市政债券的收益率（根据应税等值比较进行调整）比公司债券的收益率大幅上升。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于财经市场信号，适合用于观察利率、汇率、股债商品、金融机构和宏观政策变化。
